thread:
Ava: FYI — I sketched a short pilot to push folks from metered -> committed via a timebound usage accelerator on marketplace. idea: 3 months of 20% bonus credits for private-offer signups that commit 6 months. thoughts?
Samir: tl;dr sounds good. need to lock the math — what's the net revenue uplift vs credit cost?
Ava: rough calc: assume 30% conversion from trials, avg ARR uplift 2.5x. worst-case credit burn ~8% of first-year revenue. we can tighten via caps.
Priya: cap is key. also need partner legal ok on private offers + marketplace terms. please add sample contract language for the SI/hw partners.
Jorge: from SI side — we can co-fund credits for strategic accounts. need clear SKU mapping so our billing ties to commit SKUs.
Marta: ops questions: marketplace private offers require SKU aliasing + renewal window set to 12 months. if the offer triggers bonus credits we need a webhook to our billing to reconcile.
Ava: noted. propose minimal integration: marketplace sends order + metadata, we store offer_id, customer_id, commit_term, credit_awarded_flag. reconciliation batch daily.
Samir: can we gate credits on usage threshold? like only award once they hit 30% of committed usage in month 2 — avoids gaming.
Priya: that gating is fine but must be clear in the offer language. Legal ok with performance gates as long as they’re objective. I'll draft language.
Jorge: SI asks for co-marketing text for joint announcement. short biz-friendly line + logo usage. can marketing draft and share?
Marta: dev note — engineering needs a small endpoint: POST /marketplace/offer_events with payload: {offer_id, order_ts, customer, sku_alias, committed_units, term_months}. can we avoid complexity?
Ava: yes keep payload minimal. sample in thread. we’ll add an internal field credit_awarded=false initially.
PartnerBot: Reminder: partner compliance checklist must be completed before public announcement. link: https://redwood.internal/partners/checklist
Samir: timeline? we want to launch pilot in 6 weeks. that gives legal + eng + partner approvals.
Priya: 6 weeks is tight but doable if we parallelize. I'll own legal draft (1 week). Marta — can eng carve the endpoint and reconciliation job in 3 weeks?
Marta: yes, we can sprint. need product acceptance criteria: 1) award logic 2) reconciliation report 3) admin UI to flag offers.
Ava: admin UI can be minimal (CSV upload + status). Samir, budget approval for credit pool required — can you confirm by Friday?
Samir: pinging finance now. will reply Friday EOD.
Jorge: I'll ping SI partners to confirm co-fund interest and share the draft co-marketing.
Ava: thanks. next steps: Priya draft legal, Marta eng ticket, Jorge partner ops, Samir finance. weekly sync Wed 10am. :thumbsup:
